Plan file created at: **`/Users/naruechon/OOTD/specs/chore-7e35490c-add-enhanced-product-matching-utilities.md`**

This specification adds 6 utility functions to the outfit generator for enhanced product matching:

1. **`isFormalityCompatible`** - Checks if two formality levels are within ±2 tolerance
2. **`validatePairingCompatibility`** - Validates item compatibility using pairingCategories
3. **`calculateStyleOverlap`** - Returns 0-1 percentage of shared style tags
4. **`scoreEnhancedProductForOutfit`** - Weighted scoring with 5 criteria (aesthetic 25%, formality 25%, colorTone 20%, styleTags 15%, pairing 15%)
5. **`validateEnhancedOutfit`** - Comprehensive validation returning detailed `EnhancedValidationResult`
6. **Re-export `areColorTonesCompatible`** - Already implemented in color-palette-matcher.ts, re-exported for convenience
